source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαΐου — «Άγιος Κυπριανός ο εξ Αντιοχείας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is not the corpus's Cyprian of Antioch**, although the day's line calls him «ο εξ Αντιοχείας»: that folder is a hieromartyr and bishop whose Greek row saint.gr itself sets on 2 October, and its man is the one who died a martyr, while this entry's one sentence says «κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη», he fell asleep in peace. Two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so two men. **`types` is empty on purpose**: the page gives him no rank at all beyond «Άγιος», and a death in peace is not a rank the corpus's vocabulary holds — `venerable` would be `Όσιος`, which the page does not print. The page gives no year, so the folder has no `dates`, and the slug carries the day because the see-name is already taken by the other man. No hymn is printed for him.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
